_comment: Copy this file to %USERPROFILE%\VisionStation\backup.json and replace every value that starts with '['. The backup refuses to run while any value is still a placeholder. keep_last has no default: it is an engineer's choice of how many nightly dumps to keep. Never put a password in this file; PostgreSQL settings come from the environment and PGPASSFILE (see docs/laptop_services.md).
pg_dump: [Engineer to define: full path to pg_dump.exe, or pg_dump if it is on PATH]
